title: [P3-04] Reconcile PR ownership, merge sequence, and dependency configuration
body:
<!-- issue-734-triage:v1:start -->
## Reviewed backlog triage — #734

- Disposition: **implement**. Retain the contributor tooling and experiments acceptance as ordered implementation/integration work in Phase 3; source presence alone does not prove its acceptance.
- Accountable ledger owner: **dhar174**; existing assignees preserved.
- Canonical topic: #14 (Contributor tooling and experiments); existing native parent preserved.
- Order: Phase 3; native prerequisites #736, #735. Proposed execution prerequisites #732; handoff #737 (coordination, not an additional blocker).
- Acceptance/reproduction: Assign a reviewer and owner to each selected implementation PR and verify current CI/mergeability.; Rebase each dependent PR after its prerequisite lands; retain existing native parents and dependency links.; Update Phase/Sequence/Readiness/Depends on and create a distinct issue for every newly discovered remediation.
- Evidence: #734's reviewed ledger and retained snapshot at `13b8e374d07e7e7ea6f8f562ea6a290fcab967f7`; outcome `existing_roadmap_or_remediation_acceptance_preserved`. Unexecuted behavior is not verified.
- Closure and gate boundary: No later human gate or broader product readiness is inferred.

- Publication approved under [D027](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/blob/eb3f1e2/docs/decisions.md#d027--approve-and-publish-the-734-backlog-triage-package); preserved source evidence remains scoped as above.

<!-- issue-734-triage:v1:end -->

<!-- tiny-village-roadmap:v1:P3-04:start -->
## Ordered delivery task P3-04

Maintain the issue-backed Project as the live execution plan after backlog triage.

- Phase: 3 - Consolidate backlog and pull requests
- Sequence: 3004
- Priority: P1
- Scope: MVP
- Workstream: Planning
- Kind: Task
- Parent phase: [E3](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/733)

### Prerequisites

- [P3-01](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/734)
- [P3-02](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/735)
- [P3-03](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/736)
- [H2](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/732)

The preceding phase gate must be human-approved. Dependency closure alone does not supply a human decision.

### Acceptance criteria

- [x] Assign a reviewer and owner to each selected implementation PR and verify current CI/mergeability.
- [x] Rebase each dependent PR after its prerequisite lands; retain existing native parents and dependency links.
- [x] Update Phase/Sequence/Readiness/Depends on and create a distinct issue for every newly discovered remediation.

### Evidence to retain

Current commit/PR SHA; exact commands and executed result counts; relevant state traces/screens; review artifacts; limitations; linked follow-up issues.

<!-- tiny-village-roadmap:v1:P3-04:end -->


<!-- issue-737-authenticated-closeout:D033:v1 -->
## Scoped coordination acceptance completed

[Authenticated initial Project10 evidence and exact original files](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/blob/c7a070ba0a882bf45205a2dd3ff37e7e749d17ee/docs/planning/issue-737-publication-readback/README.md) independently verify the frozen332-issue/24-candidate configuration at merged main `dc9fcc023b4ee37b3efd579195caaab80993c64a`. The concrete plan has zero operations, fresh readback has zero differences, and unrelated-state preservation passes. No apply command was necessary. #806 was completed first after this receipt.

Acceptance reconciliation under D031–D033:
- The merged ownership matrix assigns dhar174 as accountable owner/human acceptance and Codex as technical reviewer, preserving actual assignments/review requests. Current captured heads, CI and mergeability are disclosed; absent checks/UNKNOWN mergeability do not establish integration readiness.
- The dependency-order/rebase criterion is satisfied for this coordination scope by the recorded activation and refresh policy: retained future-phase PRs rebase/retest only when their owning issue activates and prerequisites land. D032 explicitly excludes future-phase rebases now. No future implementation PR is claimed merged or accepted.
- All332 managed rows and six delivery views are verified. New remediations #806–#809 are issue-backed, with native owners/blockers preserved. #701/#704 are superseded; #709/#711/#715 remain open pending reviewed replacements under #807/#808/#809.
- #799–#803, #741, #773/#774 and other runtime requirements remain OPEN with their existing parents/dependencies. This closes ownership/order/publication acceptance, not those requirements.

Close #737 as completed under D032/D033. Final readiness is being regenerated from the actual closures for separate concrete review and owner-local inspection; it is not yet claimed published. #738 remains OPEN/Pending, #733 remains OPEN, and Phase4 remains blocked until the separate human decision.
